title: Conditional site plan approval for 384 Crawley Road
subtitle: Special meeting also included a closed session on an Ontario Land Tribunal matter and tree removal authority.
overview: Council held a short special meeting and went into closed session to receive an update on 384 Crawley Road, a matter before the Ontario Land Tribunal. Council received legal advice and information from staff, and the mayor reported that a direction had been given in closed session.

Back in open session, Council directed the General Manager of Planning and Building Services, with the General Manager of Engineering and Transportation Services and the City Solicitor, to approve a conditional site plan for Phase 0 of an industrial development at 384 Crawley Road. The approval includes authority for tree removal on the site {{vote:m2}}.

For residents, this allows the first phase of an industrial development to move ahead under conditions set by staff, and it permits trees to be removed as part of that approval. The mayor described the decision as a signal that the city is open for business. Two councillors voted against it. The meeting adjourned before a committee of the whole meeting later that day.

decisions.detail: Council directed senior staff, in consultation with the City Solicitor, to approve a conditional site plan for Phase 0 of an industrial development at 384 Crawley Road and authorize tree removal as part of that approval {{vote:m2}}.

debate: Little debate took place in open session; the direction had already been given in closed session and was brought forward for a public vote.
The mayor spoke in support, saying the project had been worked on for some time and that approving it signals the city is open for business and for collaboration.
Two councillors voted against the motion, but the transcript does not record their reasons.
